subject: Phase 100230 — Ops Doctor and Repair (diagnose/verify/doctor/repair/reindex)
verdict_justification: All five operator surfaces ship, the staged diff builds, fmt/clippy/tests are green, and an independent full coverage gate passed with 220 files and 0 below the 90% per-file bar. The remaining problems are a fudged acceptance-evidence claim (failed-verify CLI exit 1 is never tested), an inconsistent secret-redaction boundary between the CLI and MCP error paths, and scope/authorization edge cases on the newly public reindex surface.

requirements.requirement: Phase scope: bank or whole-store scope honored by reindex
requirements.evidence: rebuild.rs:75-78 scopes coverage/sweeps to the bank, but rebuild.rs:100 calls index.cleanup_orphans(), which is whole-store on both backends (index_store.rs:141-145; sqlite_index.rs:333-349). A bank-scoped reindex deletes orphan derived rows in every other bank.

issues.title: AC-100230-05 / T100230-08 claimed as passing, but the 'failed verify exits 1' path is never tested
issues.why_it_matters: The phase marks T100230-08 done and its Required Tests checklist says CLI non-zero exits are covered by ops_cli tests, yet no test or transcript exercises a verify that reports errors. The only verify CLI test asserts exit 0 on an empty store. This is a required acceptance criterion with no real evidence.
issues.impact: A regression that breaks NFR-8's CI gate for verify (e.g. verify returning ok=true despite error findings) would not be caught. The completion evidence overstates what was verified.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-lib/src/ops_cli.rs:313-421 tests contain no failing-verify case; line 156 (ExitCode::from(1) in run_verify) is uncovered in an independent coverage JSON; phase file line 308,324,341.
issues.proposed_fix: Add an ops_cli test that plants an integrity fault in a temp sqlite file (or injects an OpsStore double) so run_verify returns exit 1, and record the captured transcript in Completion Evidence.

issues.title: MCP ops error and repair-detail messages are not credential-redacted, unlike the CLI
issues.why_it_matters: §4.9.7 forbids returning unmasked credentials from diagnose/doctor/repair surfaces. The CLI author added redact() precisely because driver errors can embed connection URLs, but the MCP path and the repair action details do not apply it, so the same error leaks over MCP what the CLI hides.
issues.impact: A Postgres connection error could surface a URL with an embedded password in an MCP tool result (content/structuredContent) or in a repair action detail printed by CLI --confirm.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-mcp/src/ops_tools.rs:145-158 copies err.message verbatim into message and findings; crates/clio-ops/src/repair.rs:280 and :325 interpolate raw {e} into ActionOutcome.detail; crates/clio-lib/src/ops_cli.rs:283-290 is the only redaction helper and is CLI-only.
issues.proposed_fix: Promote a single shared redactor (URL userinfo stripping) and apply it in error_envelope and to every ActionOutcome.detail built from an error.

issues.title: Bank-scoped reindex runs whole-store orphan cleanup
issues.why_it_matters: The public reindex contract says a bank or the whole store can be targeted. The orphan-cleanup step inside the sweep ignores the scope and deletes derived rows in every bank, so a scoped operation mutates data outside its scope (and reruns redundantly once per bank on whole-store runs).
issues.impact: An operator reindexing one bank can drop orphan vectors/lexical docs/queue rows belonging to other banks, including banks the caller was not authorized for.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-index/src/rebuild.rs:84-101 calls index.cleanup_orphans() inside the per-scope loop; the trait method takes no bank (crates/clio-store/src/index_store.rs:141-145) and the SQLite implementation deletes globally (crates/clio-store/src/sqlite_index.rs:333-349).
issues.proposed_fix: Run cleanup once per call and, when a bank scope is given, either skip cleanup or add a bank-filtered cleanup so scoped reindex never touches other banks.

issues.title: Shared-bank permission is bypassed by calling reindex without a bank
issues.why_it_matters: The deployment gate for the cross-agent `shared` namespace is meant to block all access unless enabled. reindex calls resolve_ctx (which checks the default/args bank) but then passes the raw bank arg to reindex; when omitted, the rebuild expands to every indexable bank, including `shared`.
issues.impact: A caller on a deployment with the shared bank disabled can still mutate the shared bank's derived index state by omitting `bank`.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-mcp/src/ops_tools.rs:109-122 (resolve_ctx result discarded; bank: opt_str(args,"bank")), crates/clio-mcp/src/runtime.rs:278-302 (only gate is bank == shared), crates/clio-index/src/rebuild.rs:75-78 (None -> indexable_banks()).
issues.proposed_fix: Use the resolved context bank when args omit one, or reject a bank-less reindex/repair when the deployment has the shared bank disabled, or exclude the shared bank from the default scope.

issues.title: IndexCoordinator rebuild sweep no longer records embed latency/error in worker state
issues.why_it_matters: The refactor moved the sweep out of worker.rs but the new free rebuild() calls embedder.embed_batch directly, whereas the old sweep_dense used self.embed_and_observe, which records last_latency_ms/last_error surfaced by status().
issues.impact: Rolling diagnostics silently stop reflecting rebuild embed activity; a failing embed during rebuild no longer populates last_error (the Err still propagates to the caller).
issues.evidence: crates/clio-index/src/worker.rs:191-201 delegates rebuild_indexes to crate::rebuild::rebuild; crates/clio-index/src/rebuild.rs:174-191 uses raw embed_batch; the removed self.embed_and_observe path remains only for process_one (worker.rs:257-282).
issues.proposed_fix: Have rebuild accept an optional observe callback, or route the coordinator through a thin wrapper that records latency/error, preserving the documented Phase 100110 observability.

issues.title: New Postgres-open MCP test bypasses PG_TEST_LOCK serialization
issues.why_it_matters: coverage.md §4.4 requires all shared-Postgres test access to be serialized with PG_TEST_LOCK. opens_postgres_when_database_url_configured runs whenever DATABASE_URL points at postgres (including every make coverage run) and opens/migrates the shared database with no lock, while clio-store pg tests delete and restore schema_settings under the lock.
issues.impact: A race between this open (migration/version check) and pg_ops_tests' schema_version deletion is a plausible intermittent coverage-gate failure.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-mcp/src/runtime_tests.rs:302-315; crates/clio-store/src/pg_ops_tests.rs:97-113 deletes the schema_version row; PG_TEST_LOCK is private to clio-store (crates/clio-store/src/pg_lock.rs).
issues.proposed_fix: Gate the open test behind a serialized lock, or drop it in favor of an am-store-covered postgres path, or skip it unless an explicit AM_PG_OPEN_TEST env is set.

issues.title: Optional MemTree ancestor reindex silently omitted from Known Limitations
issues.why_it_matters: Phase Task 5 lists 'optional MemTree ancestor materializations'. Optional means it need not be built, but the developer rules require any silently skipped in-scope item to be disclosed with what/why/owner. The phase's Known Limitations never mention it.
issues.impact: A reader could infer reindex materializes ancestors when it cannot.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-index/src/report.rs:26-32 (Dense|Lexical|All only); roadmap/phase-100230-ops-doctor-repair.md §12 Known Limitations (lines 428-431) omits ancestor materialization.
issues.proposed_fix: Add a Known Limitations bullet: MemTree ancestor materialization not implemented (optional; no target), why, and owning phase.

issues.title: Attribution row does not match the instructed agent label
issues.why_it_matters: The developer task instructed an exact attribution string; the phase file records a different agent identity, which weakens run provenance.
issues.impact: Audit trail attributes the work to the wrong agent string.
issues.evidence: roadmap/phase-100230-ops-doctor-repair.md:6 ('OpenCode CLI (Go . Deepseek V4.1 Flash High)') versus the developer task instruction ('OpenCode CLI (Together . GLM-5.3 Flash High)').
issues.proposed_fix: Correct the Developer attribution row to the instructed label (or confirm the label actually used).

issues.title: MCP schema descriptions for diagnose/repair bank scope do not match behavior
issues.why_it_matters: schema_ops_defs says diagnose's bank is 'used only for failure findings' (diagnose ignores it entirely) and repair's bank means 'whole store when omitted' (repair with omitted bank fails every action with no bank scope).
issues.impact: Agents relying on the advertised contract get surprising fallbacks/failures.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-mcp/src/schema_ops_defs.rs:39 and :79; crates/clio-mcp/src/ops_tools.rs:62-69 (no bank passed to diagnose); crates/clio-ops/src/repair.rs:272-275 (action requires a bank scope).
issues.proposed_fix: Either wire the bank through (diagnose failure scope; repair default bank) or correct the schema text to state the actual behavior.

strengths: Clean crate boundary: clio-ops owns semantics, clio-store owns SQL, clio-mcp/clio-lib own bindings; headers accurately describe ownership.
doctor/repair separation is real: doctor cannot mutate, and there is no erase/DEK path in repair.
Solid unit coverage for refusal, confirmation, allowlist, residual re-verify, and dimension-drift fail-closed paths.
MCP structured-failure shape is consistent and the shared dispatch path means stdio and HTTP get identical semantics.
Independent coverage, test, lint, format, and CLI transcript reproduction all match the phase's claims.
regrets: The developer left /tmp/cov-final.json as the failed pre-fix run, making it easy to mistake for the final evidence; naming it cov-failed.json would avoid ambiguity.
The verify-failure exit path was mapped but never demonstrated, so the strongest CI guarantee rests on code reading.
process_changes: Require a captured transcript for every exit code named in an acceptance criterion, not just the ones easy to trigger.
Apply one shared redaction helper across CLI and MCP error surfaces rather than adding it per-caller.
plan_1hr: Add an ops_cli test that forces a failing verify and asserts exit 1; record the transcript.
Apply the CLI redactor inside MCP error_envelope and repair action details.
Document the optional MemTree ancestor reindex omission in Known Limitations.
plan_unlimited: Make orphan cleanup bank-scoped (or skip on scoped reindex) and add a hostile multi-bank test.
Thread the resolved context bank through repair/reindex so the shared-bank gate cannot be bypassed by omitting bank.
Restore rebuild-sweep observability by routing coordinator sweeps through the observing embed path.
Add ops tools to the stdio/HTTP parity suite and a transactional test asserting no cross-bank mutation.
